evidence: Library shows 6 templates each with title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description text.
Each card shows title, category tag, scenario tag, author, usage count, update date (e.g. Professional Resume, Business, Resume, Sarah Chen, 1,250 uses, Updated 2024-12-01).
Clicking Use Template opens dialog with template details (title, category, scenario, author, uses) and a Fill Template tab with the template's fields.

Dialog shows warning banner: 'Required fields missing / Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills' and Preview Result tab is disabled.
Preview Result tab is disabled until required fields are filled (observed in initial empty-form state).

All 14 fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills) accepted typed values.
After filling required fields, Preview Result tab became enabled and displayed generated markdown with values substituted (Timothee Issenmann, Software Engineer, Acme Corp, etc.).
Preview renders H1/H2/H3 headings, bold (strong) text, italic (emphasis) text, and a separator; all placeholders replaced with entered values.
Professional Resume markdown template rendered headings, bold, italics, separator correctly with substituted values.

issue: Email field does not validate format
actual: Entered 'invalid-email' (not a valid email) into the required Email field; the app did not reject it, enabled the Preview tab, and rendered 'invalid-email' verbatim in the generated preview instead of rejecting the value or keeping preview unavailable.

evidence: Clicking Copy to Clipboard triggered a toast notification 'Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied.'
Typing '<script>' and other special chars into Full Name triggered inline error 'Special characters like < > { } [ ] \ | \` are not allowed' and disabled the Preview Result tab.

Clicking heart icon on cards added them to favorites (count went 0→1→2); clicking header Favorites button opened a favorites-only view showing 'Showing 2 of 6 templates' with only the favorited items.
While in favorites-only view, typing 'Weekly' in search narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' displaying only Weekly Status Report.
Clicking heart icon immediately updated header Favorites count badge (0→1→2) and card visual active state changed.

Typing 're' showed a suggestion dropdown (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, Degree, Weekly Status Report, In Progress); clicking 'Weekly Status Report' filled the search box and narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates'.

actual: Searching 'Reusme' (transposed) and 'Resme' (missing letter) as typos of 'Resume' both returned 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' / 'No templates found', with no suggestions and no matching template returned. Search only performs exact substring matching, not fuzzy matching.

evidence: Category filter 'Weekly Report' narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6'. Sort By offers Most Popular, Recently Updated, Oldest First, Alphabetical; selecting Alphabetical reordered cards to Academic, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report (A→W order).
Category and sort changes updated the visible card list and 'Showing X of 6' count instantly without any page navigation/reload.
Submitting the Submit Template form completely empty produced toast 'Missing required fields / Please fill in all required fields.' and did not submit.
Filled title, author, description, category, scenario, markdown content, and one field (Reporter); submission succeeded with toast 'Template submitted! Your template has been added to the library.'
Immediately after submission, without reload, the library count updated from 'Showing 6 of 6' to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' and a new 'QA Bug Report' card appeared.

issue: Custom template submission does not validate field/placeholder mapping
actual: Submitted a template whose content contained placeholders {{reporter}}, {{summary}}, {{severity}} but only one field 'Reporter' (mapped to {{reporter}}) was declared. The submission succeeded without any warning about the unmapped {{summary}} and {{severity}} placeholders, instead of being rejected.

evidence: After submission, 'QA Bug Report' card appeared in the library; clicking 'Use Template' opened its fill form and preview.

issue: Custom template submission does not validate field/placeholder mapping; generated preview contains unresolved placeholders
actual: Submitted a template with content placeholders {{reporter}}, {{summary}}, {{severity}} but only declared one field (Reporter). Submission succeeded without warning. When using the template, its preview literally displayed unresolved '{{summary}}' and '{{severity}}' text instead of being blocked or substituted.

issue: Duplicate field labels are not rejected or disambiguated
actual: Added two custom fields both labeled 'Name' (mapped to same {{name}} placeholder) during template submission; the app allowed both to be added and submitted without any warning. When filling the resulting template, React threw a console error 'Encountered two children with the same key' and the second 'Name' field rendered as an unlabeled textbox, making the fields not independently/reliably fillable.

evidence: After navigating/reloading to http://localhost:6089/, Favorites count remained '2' and both custom templates (QA Bug Report, Dup Field Test) were still present, showing 'Showing 8 of 8 templates'.
